subject_group: 13.1 Component and subsystem electromagnetic environmental effects qualification

versions.title_at_revision: Verify that all flight-critical equipment complies with the electromagnetic interference requirements that are appropriate for the system application or appropriate flight restrictions are imposed in the flight manuals for exceptions.

versions.title_at_revision: Verify that all flight-critical equipment complies with all electromagnetic environmental effects requirements, including lightning susceptibility, that are appropriate for the system application; or verify that appropriate flight restrictions are imposed.
versions.text: Verify that all flight-critical equipment complies with all electromagnetic environmental effects requirements, including lightning susceptibility, that are appropriate for the system application; or verify that appropriate flight restrictions are imposed. Comm’l Doc: RTCA DO-160 sections 18 through 22; SAE ARP5412, section 4. DoD/MIL Doc: MIL-STD-461, section 5; MIL-STD-464, section 5.4.

Criterion: Verify that all flight-critical and safety-critical equipment comply with all electromagnetic environmental effects requirements, including lightning susceptibility, that are appropriate for the system application; or verify that appropriate flight restrictions are imposed. Standard: All equipment and subsystems comply with the conducted and radiated emissions and conducted and radiated susceptibility requirements of MIL-STD-461, section 5, MIL-STD- 464, 5.5 or equivalent requirements from industry/commercial standards such as RTCA DO- 160, sections 18 through 22 and SAE ARP5412. Method of Compliance: Verification methods of MIL-STD-461, section 5 or equivalent verification methods from industry/commercial standards such as RTCA DO-160, sections 18 through 22 (for Army, Section 22 only) demonstrate that the equipment complies with the emissions and susceptibility requirements. References: MIL-STD-461: section 5 MIL-STD-464: 5.5 SAE ARP5412 RTCA DO-160: sections 18 through 22

Standard: All flight-critical and safety-critical equipment comply with the EMI control requirements for emissions and susceptibility (considering air vehicle type, mission, equipment functionality, and installation) using the safety-critical limits as specified in MIL-STD-461, Detailed Requirements paragraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Verify that the equipment meets the applicable MIL-STD-461 test requirements and limits considering air vehicle type, mission, equipment functionality, and installation by reviewing and analyzing the EMI test procedures. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Electromagnetic interference tests verify requirements were met using proper test setup for the system application, appropriate modes of operation are executed during testing, and compliance to the applicable limits.
